Name: Total Rehaul
Author: BrutalCleric
Description:
Tons of new furniture options. Works with Custom Furniture. I have separated into 4 different files, so you can pick and choose what you want to use. Must have [b]Custom Furniture [/b]installed. 

Main File: [b]Total Rehaul[/b]- 
16 new Dining Chairs
4 new Benches
6 new Arm Chairs
7 new Couches
5 new Dressers
1 Coffee Table
3 New Dining Tables
2 Desks 
1 Picnic Table 
2 China Cabinets
2 Bookshelves
7 Side Tables 
2 Lamps 
1 Kitchen Counter perfect for that empty spot in the upgraded kitchen
and various Decorative items.

Optional File 1: [b]Total Rehaul.Rugs[/b]

Adds 22 new Rug options. 

Optional File 2: [b]Total Rehaul.Toys[/b]

Adds 80+ Kids Toys

Optional File 3: [b]Total Rehaul.Art

[/b]Adds 25 Classic Paintings, 2 Day of the Dead Skeleton Masks, 2 Egyptian Cat Statues, and a couple of Tribal Masks

Special shout out to the [b]Sundrop City[/b] team( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4014]Sundrop City at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url])- 

They have graciously allowed me to use some furniture items in this mod 

White Egg Chair
Orange U-Shaped Chair
Orange U-Shaped Couch
BBQ (by [b]ChefRude[/b]) 
Rattan Chair and Side Table
Orange Potted Plant
Blue Vase
White and Orange Potted Plant and 
Yellow Vase.


FYI, This is only the 2nd Mod I've ever made so please be understanding. Will try my best to help anyone that has an issue but It may be a case of the blind leading the blind.  If you comment in comments tab, I may not answer immediately. Kids, spouse, job and all manner of real life, keeps me pretty busy. Hope you enjoy.
